mechanism: Torsemide-induced hypokalemia and hyponatremia can increase QT prolongation risk, and citalopram dose-dependently prolongs QT interval; loop diuretics also increase serotonin syndrome risk through volume depletion.
action: Monitor electrolytes (especially potassium) regularly, obtain baseline ECG, monitor QTc interval, and consider alternative diuretic or reduce citalopram dose if QTc >500ms or increases >60ms from baseline.
